# Stories by Foot

> Stories by Foot is a tour and travel company offering domestic and international tour packages, group trips, bike trips, and road trips with verified stays and 24/7 support.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.storiesbyfoot.com/): Overview of tour packages, popular destinations, hot departures, and travel services.
- [Upcoming Trips & Destinations](https://www.storiesbyfoot.com/destinations): Browse and filter domestic and international group trips and tour packages.
- [Services](https://www.storiesbyfoot.com/services): Tour logistics, backup vehicles, road captains, medical oxygen support, and custom trip planning.
- [Support & FAQ](https://www.storiesbyfoot.com/support): Booking help, packing lists, permits, and cancellation/refund policies.
- [Travel Blog](https://www.storiesbyfoot.com/blog): Route guides, trip cost breakdowns, and seasonal travel tips.
- [About Us](https://www.storiesbyfoot.com/about): Company background, mission, and team.
- [Contact](https://www.storiesbyfoot.com/contact): Phone (+91 6205129118), email (contact@storiesbyfoot.com), and callback inquiries.
